summary:
Implementation plan for resolving mobile wrapping issues across the app and overhauling the Vehicle Details mobile tab navigation:
1. Mobile Header & Card Wrapping Fixes: Eliminating orphan bullet points, text clipping on Sponsored badges, cramped author headers in CommunityPollCard and standard posts via responsive icon buttons and flex-wrap stabilization.
2. Vehicle Details Mobile Tab Navigation: Replacing horizontal scrolling with a sleek full-width 4-button segmented bar (Technical Sheet, About the Build, Photos, Discussions).
3. 'About the Build' Mobile Section: Moving the Story, Builder Profile, Crew & Sponsors, and More Builds to a dedicated mobile section before Photos, while maintaining the dual-column desktop layout.
